# Plan ₿ Academy

> Free, open-source Bitcoin education platform by Plan ₿ Network
> (planb.network). Also known as Plan B Academy / Plan B Network Academy.
> 50+ courses in 28 languages. Community-driven, no trading,
> no token — pure education.

Plan ₿ Academy (planb.academy) is the world's largest open-source Bitcoin
education platform. All course content is freely available and community-translated.
The full content library is also available as markdown files on GitHub at
github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content.

planb.academy and the GitHub repository contain the same educational content.
The website is the learning platform (courses, progress tracking, diplomas).
The GitHub repository is the open-source content library (markdown files,
community contributions, translations).

## Key Facts

- 50+ structured courses, 400+ hours of content, from beginner to expert
  (100-level to 400-level), combining text chapters, video lectures
  (424 videos), and quizzes (3,000+ questions)
- Two learning formats: self-paced courses (free, open-source, available to
  everyone) and live classes led by professors (online, in-person, or hybrid
  — some free, some paid)
- 316 step-by-step tutorials: wallet setup, node installation, privacy tools,
  P2P exchanges, computer security, mining hardware, and merchant solutions
- 768-term Bitcoin glossary (largest multilingual Bitcoin glossary)
- 1,793 curated resources (books, podcasts, tools, conferences)
- 6,551 registered students
- 2,334 course diplomas issued (PGP-signed, timestamped) + B-CERT, a global
  Bitcoin certification exam held in 14 countries (560+ participants)
- 478 Bitcoin communities worldwide, 54 actively using the platform
- 100% free self-paced content, open-source (GitHub), no token, no trading
- Available in 28 languages: English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German,
  Italian, Dutch, Polish, Czech, Swedish, Finnish, Norwegian, Estonian,
  Indonesian, Vietnamese, Turkish, Serbian, Swahili, Kirundi, Russian,
  Bulgarian, Arabic, Persian, Hindi, Thai, Korean, Japanese, Chinese
  (Simplified & Traditional)

## Courses — Bitcoin

Courses covering what Bitcoin is, how it works, how to buy, store, and use
it securely, and how to build communities around it.

- [The Bitcoin Journey](https://planb.academy/en/courses/the-bitcoin-journey-2b7dc507-81e3-4b70-88e6-41ed44239966): 7 hours, beginner. Discover Bitcoin fundamentals, including its monetary value proposition, miners, transactions, and wallets. Most popular course (837 ratings, 4.69/5). [Source](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/courses/btc101)
- [Getting your first bitcoins](https://planb.academy/en/courses/getting-your-first-bitcoins-f3e3843d-1a1d-450c-96d6-d7232158b81f): 14 hours, beginner. Learn how to buy, secure, and manage your first bitcoins independently. [Source](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/courses/btc102)
- [Setting up your first Bitcoin node](https://planb.academy/en/courses/mettre-en-place-son-premier-nœud-bitcoin-3cd9cb94-82e8-417a-9c5a-02afc2589426): 10 hours, intermediate. Understand, install, configure, and use a Bitcoin node. [Source](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/courses/btc202)
- [Privacy on Bitcoin](https://planb.academy/en/courses/la-confidentialité-sur-bitcoin-65c138b0-4161-4958-bbe3-c12916bc959c): 16 hours, intermediate. Understand and master the principles of privacy protection when using Bitcoin. [Source](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/courses/btc204)
- [History of the Cypherpunks](https://planb.academy/en/courses/au-cœur-de-la-géopolitique-de-bitcoin-8a6d2cba-ced8-11f0-833a-638aea8a47f1): 3 hours, intermediate. Understand why money in general, and Bitcoin in particular, are geopolitical objects. [Source](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/courses/btc208)
- [Bitcoin Development Philosophy](https://planb.academy/en/courses/bitcoin-development-philosophy-cad798e6-3acf-11f0-b82c-771d758cf407): 8 hours, advanced. Develop a deep philosophical understanding of Bitcoin's design principles. [Source](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/courses/btc303)
- [How to Create a Bitcoin Community](https://planb.academy/en/courses/créer-une-communauté-bitcoin-1c643dc9-a15f-4f9e-93b6-cb3c58b4ee35): 7 hours, advanced. Easily create and organize a Bitcoin community in your local area. [Source](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/courses/btc304)

## Courses — Protocol

Lightning Network, sidechains (Liquid, RGB, Taproot Assets), software
development, networking, and Bitcoin protocol internals.

### Lightning Network

Discover the Lightning Network from a technical perspective — how Bitcoin's layer-2 payment network works. [Source](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/courses/lnp201)
- [Set up Your First Lightning Node](https://planb.academy/en/courses/mettre-en-place-son-premier-nœud-lightning-593e483e-1785-4e83-aa7e-32b99056844c): 7 hours, intermediate. Understand, install, configure, and use a Lightning node. [Source](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/courses/lnp202)
- [Hands-on with Breez Nodeless SDK](https://planb.academy/en/courses/hands-on-with-breez-nodeless-sdk-a1b2c3d4-5e6f-7g8h-9i0j-k1l2m3n4o5p6): 4 hours, intermediate. Master the Breez Nodeless SDK to build Lightning Network applications without running a node. [Source](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/courses/lnp206)
- [Navigating Your Node with Terminal](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/courses/lnp404): 16 hours, intermediate. Take a deep dive into your Lightning node with Terminal. (GitHub only — not yet on platform)

### Sidechain (Liquid Network)

[Source](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/courses/sid302)
- [Mastering Liquid Engineering](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/courses/sid402): 8 hours, expert. Master the Liquid Network and Elements, from node operations to confidential transactions and asset issuance. (GitHub only — not yet on platform)

Economics, history, philosophy, and political thought — the intellectual
foundations that give Bitcoin its context and meaning.

## Tutorials

316 step-by-step practical guides organized by category and subcategory:

- [Wallet tutorials](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/tutorials/wallet) (99 tutorials)
  - Desktop wallets: Electrum, Sparrow, Liana, Nunchuk, Blue Wallet, Wasabi
  - Hardware wallets: Coldcard (MK4, Q), Ledger (Nano S Plus, Flex), Trezor (Safe 3, Safe 5), BitBox02, Jade, SeedSigner, Passport, Bitkey
  - Mobile wallets: Phoenix, Aqua, Breez, Zeus, Wallet of Satoshi, Bitcoin Keeper, Blink, Cake Wallet
  - Backup & recovery: mnemonic phrase generation, passphrase setup, recovery test, BIP-85, inheritance planning
  - Multisig setups: Liana, Nunchuk, Sparrow multisig
- [Computer Security tutorials](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/tutorials/computer-security) (79 tutorials)
  - Operating systems: GrapheneOS, Tails, Qubes OS, Ubuntu
  - VPN: Mullvad VPN, IVPN, Proton VPN
  - Password managers & authentication: Bitwarden, KeePass, Aegis, Ente Auth, security keys (2FA)
  - Encrypted communication: Signal, SimpleX, Session, Proton Mail, Keet
  - Browsers & network privacy: Tor Browser, Mullvad Browser, Pi-hole, OPNsense
  - Data protection: Proton Drive, VeraCrypt
- [Exchange tutorials](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/tutorials/exchange) (36 tutorials)
  - Peer-to-peer exchanges: Bisq, Robosats, Peach, HodlHodl, LNP2PBot, Vexl, Mostro
  - Centralized exchanges: Kraken, Bitstamp, Bitfinex, Paymium
  - DCA & recurring buys: Relai, Stackinsat, Bitstack, Bittr
  - Regional services: Bull Bitcoin, BitcoinVN, Bitika, Ejara
- [Node tutorials](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/tutorials/node) (28 tutorials)
  - Bitcoin nodes: Bitcoin Core (Linux, Mac, Windows), Bitcoin Knots, Umbrel, RaspiBlitz, Start9, Ronin Dojo
  - Lightning nodes: Alby Hub, Phoenixd, LND, Ride the Lightning, ThunderHub
  - Network tools: Mempool.space, Amboss, LN Plus
- [Business tutorials](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/tutorials/business) (24 tutorials)
  - Merchant payment solutions: BTCPay Server, Swiss Bitcoin Pay, Coinos, OpenNode, LNbits
  - Point-of-sale: Breez POS, Lipa Business
  - Accounting: Divly
- [Contributing to Plan ₿ Academy](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/tutorials/contribution) (20 tutorials): How to write tutorials, translate content via Weblate, add resources (books, events, podcasts), proofread and review
- [Privacy tutorials](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/tutorials/privacy) (18 tutorials)
  - CoinJoin & mixing: Whirlpool, JoinMarket, Joinstr
  - Transaction privacy: PayNym (BIP47), Payjoin, Stonewall, Ricochet
  - UTXO management: coin control, UTXO labelling, mempool.space analysis
- [Mining tutorials](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/tutorials/mining) (12 tutorials)
  - Hardware: BitAxe, NerdMiner, NerdAxe, Canaan Avalon, Attakai (heat your home while mining)
  - Mining pools: Braiins Pool, Ocean Pool, Public Pool

## Bitcoin Glossary

- [Full glossary](https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content/tree/main/resources/glossary): 768 Bitcoin and cryptocurrency terms defined in 28 languages — the largest multilingual Bitcoin glossary available. Each term has its own dedicated page. Covers technical terms (UTXO, mempool, hash rate, nonce, difficulty adjustment), economic concepts (inflation, sound money, time preference, Cantillon effect), and protocol-specific terminology (SegWit, Taproot, Lightning channels, BIP).

## Educator Content

A collaborative library where Bitcoin educators worldwide upload and share
their teaching materials — so other teachers can download, edit, and reuse
them instead of starting from scratch. 52 items available in 4 languages.

Content types: presentations, flyers, curricula, workshop materials,
educational games, booklets, stickers, and artwork. All downloadable,
most editable. Licensed under Creative Commons (CC-BY-SA default).

Community-driven: educators submit, Plan ₿ Academy moderates. Contributors
include local Bitcoin communities (Bitcoin Lille, Annecy Bitcoin Meetup) and
international education organizations (My First Bitcoin).

## Certification

Plan ₿ Academy offers two levels of credential:

**Course diplomas**: Complete any self-paced course and pass the quizzes to
earn a diploma. 2,334 diplomas issued to date. Diplomas are
PGP-signed and timestamped via Open Timestamp Server.

**B-CERT — Global Bitcoin Certification**: A 1-hour in-person examination
testing comprehensive Bitcoin knowledge. 560+ participants across 34
sessions in 14 countries. The only active Bitcoin certification program
worldwide. Free for participants (hosted at conferences, universities,
and Bitcoin hubs).

## About Plan ₿ Network

- Website: https://planb.academy
- Parent organization: https://planb.network
- GitHub: https://github.com/PlanB-Network/bitcoin-educational-content
- Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/planaboratorio
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@PlanBNetwork

Plan ₿ Academy is the e-learning platform of Plan ₿ Network. The website
(planb.academy) and the GitHub repository (bitcoin-educational-content)
contain the same educational content in the same 28 languages. The website
provides the learning experience (progress tracking, quizzes, diplomas).
The GitHub repository is the open-source content library where anyone can
contribute translations, corrections, and new content.
